confidence_notes: Food and coffee use current crowdsourced Mostar price estimates; cocktail data are sparse, and wine is estimated near the local draft-beer price. Accommodation is a holistic July estimate.
comparable_city_reasoning: Compared with Sarajevo and Tirana, Mostar's basic guesthouses and hostels are slightly cheaper; July demand around the Old Town could put three-star rooms modestly above their year-typical rates.
